invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Drawable, chosen from style fields which are expected to be non-null.

invariants.expression: result == (node.expanded ? style.minus : style.plus) || result == (node.expanded ? style.minusOver : style.plusOver)
invariants.rationale: Result is always determined by either the normal icons or the hover (Over) variants depending on control flow.
If the node is expanded, only minus or minusOver icons can be returned.
If the node is not expanded, only plus or plusOver icons can be returned.
